topic: Electromagnetic Spectrum and EM Wave Properties
key_concepts: Electromagnetic spectrum arranges EM waves by frequency, wavelength, and photon energy
Seven EM regions: radio waves, microwaves, infrared, visible light, ultraviolet, X-rays, a
Wavelength and frequency are inversely proportional
Frequency and energy are directly proportional
EM waves are transverse waves with perpendicular electric and magnetic fields
Changing electric and magnetic fields generate each other
EM waves can travel through a vacuum at 3 × 10^8 m/s
Scientists Maxwell, Hertz, Oersted, and Ampere contributed to EM wave theory
Wave characteristics include crest, trough, wavelength, frequency, amplitude, and period
